introduction.goal: Open and close a short meeting in the stated context.
introduction.usageNote: Bonjour opens this daytime meeting. Salut is available in the familiar-friend scene; au revoir closes it. More than one greeting can be natural, so tasks specify the intended phrase or exclude equally suitable options.
introduction.dialectNote: Reference target: contemporary everyday Metropolitan French. Familiar tu and polite singular vous are explicitly assigned by scene, not inferred from age or appearance. No regional alternative is claimed without a reviewed source.
introduction.recordingNote: Unreviewed private text draft. No human model audio or phonetic transcription. Device speech, if available, is a preview, not pronunciation evidence.
